existing_history_input.source: JRA official race card and horse information pages

history_collector.note: The current-date entry-point collector cannot itself retrieve past-date racecards. Historical validation uses horse IDs from historical JRA results and retrieved horse information pages. Pages are current at fetch time; discard runs on or after each target race date. Local racing history is present in horse information pages, but local class data is not assumed.

notes: B and its original prediction files remain unchanged.
